```card-forge
card:
  system: dcc
  card-type: equipment
data:
  # The card's name. Falls back to the file name.
  name:

  # Flavour or a short description, in italics.
  description:

  # The roll the entry is listed under in its table — a badge beside the title. `roll-min` and `roll-max` beside it are the numbers.
  roll:

  # Source reference — rulebook page or wikilink, small at the foot's right.
  reference:

  # English original name, small at the foot's left, prefixed "engl."; hidden on English cards.
  original-name:

  # The kind of equipment, as it is to stand under the title — "Weapon", "Armor", "Ammunition", "Gear", "Mount".
  type:

  # Price in the rulebook's coin — gold pieces (gp), silver pieces (sp), copper pieces (cp).
  cost:

  # A weapon's damage die, e.g. "1d8".
  damage:

  # A ranged weapon's range — short/medium/long, e.g. "70/140/210".
  range:

  # An armour's bonus to Armor Class; the sign is added (`5` prints "+5").
  ac-bonus:

  # An armour's penalty on checks; the sign is added.
  check-penalty:

  # An armour's penalty to speed, e.g. "-5'".
  speed-penalty:

  # The fumble die while wearing this armour, e.g. "d12".
  fumble-die:

  # Items per unit — arrows to a quiver.
  quantity:

  # Weight, where the table gives one.
  weight:

  # The rulebook's footnotes that apply to this item — a list, each entry an italic line at the foot.
  notes:
```
